text: Mum, the new Batman film starts this week. Tom from school is going to the 9 o'clock showing tomorrow. Can I go too? Not at 9 o'clock on a school day. What other showings are there? Um, 4.30 and 7 o'clock. Well, there won't be time to make the 4.30 after school, so if you go tomorrow it will have to be 7 o'clock. Okay, I'll text Tom and ask him to go at 7-2.
